text.p: These are the leading stories in the Skopje press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Macedonian railways are in financial difficulty, with a $13 million debt in the first half of the year. It needs $30 million a year to maintain operations.
- Macedonian meat producers protest and demand tax exemption for import of fodder.
- Macedonia is setting an example in successful preventive diplomacy, concludes international seminar organised by U.N. mission.

- "Turks from Macedonia are incorporated in the system and will never act as satellites in someone else's interest," says leadership of Democracy Party of Turks at the third party congress in Struga. -- Mircela Casule, Skopje newsroom +389 91 201196
